# GEL.IT.UP

> GEL.IT.UP is a B2B wholesale professional gel nail brand selling to nail technicians, salons, and academies in 15+ countries. Manufactured in the EU. All products are HEMA-free, TPO-free, and Silver (CI 77820)-free, Leaping Bunny Approved, and formulated to strict EU cosmetic regulations.

## Products
- 1,000+ gel polish shades
- Builder gel systems (3-in-1 Premium, Liquid Polygel, Multimix Synthogel, BIAB, brush-on)
- Base coats, top coats, nail art, tools, consumables

## Key facts
- HEMA-free, TPO-free, Silver (CI 77820)-free
- Leaping Bunny Approved (cruelty-free)
- EU-certified, manufactured in the EU
- Sold wholesale to 1,000+ professionals in 15+ countries
- Public catalogue with visible wholesale pricing at gelitup.com/full-catalogue
- Distributor and academy partnership programs available
